root: Agents can distill failed runs, stage one scoped adapter change, verify it, promote it, inspect durable attempt history, and restore the prior overlay through one local lifecycle.
Paired baseline and candidate execution now requires strict validation improvement, every predicted fix, an independent held-out split, and zero measured regressions.
Agent Plugins 1.0 Skills and configuration-only MCP packages now project into the operation catalog, CLI, MCP, and ACP surfaces.
The documentation now organizes repair and evolution as one workflow, and the mobile navigation button keeps its intended layout and tap target.
zh: Agent 现在可以在一条本地流程中提炼失败 run、暂存一次 scoped adapter 修改、验证并晋级候选、检查持久化尝试记录，以及恢复原有 overlay。
baseline 与 candidate 的成对执行现在要求 validation 严格提升、所有预测修复成立、held-out split 独立且完整，并且没有测得回退。
Agent Plugins 1.0 Skills 和仅含配置的 MCP package 现在可以投影到 operation catalog、CLI、MCP 和 ACP。
文档现已把 repair 与 evolution 组织成同一条工作流，手机端导航按钮也恢复了预期布局和点击区域。
